views.title: Korean T9 search for the Phone app

views.markdown: Search contacts by Korean initial consonants directly from the Phone keypad.

- Korean and English T9 search modes
- Inline swipe by default, with an optional result sheet
- Optional phone-number search and key haptics
- Speed dial on keys 2–9
- Toggleable Korean keypad labels on iOS 26–27 and reversible keypad images on earlier versions
- Highlight color and family-name-first display options
- Required color-picker dependency bundled in one package

views.title: vPhone RootHide
views.text: Korean initial-consonant search verified on iOS 26.6.2 and 27.1

views.markdown:
### 2.3.6

- Fixed a keypad crash on iOS 27.1 and moved search results to the left pane in the unfolded Duo layout.
- Added Korean initials below the Latin letters on iOS 26–27.
- Made inline swipe the default. The result sheet uses T9Dialer’s own search when the Phone app’s search API is incompatible.

### 2.3.0

- Reimplemented the original search and result UI from reverse-engineered behavior.
- Fixed preference persistence, phone-number search, haptics, and highlight colors.
- Added iOS 18 search support and speed dial.
- Integrated Korean keypad images and required dependencies.
- Added a reversible Korean keypad toggle.
